profile.title: Profiles
profile.hint: Pick a profile for a new conversation: it brings its model, reasoning and approval mode, limits the tools the assistant may use and adds its instructions.
profile.toolsHint: Leave empty to allow all tools. Select your available system tools or enter another tool identifier. Existing selections are preserved.
profile.toolsLoadFailed: Could not load tools. Existing selections are preserved; close and retry.

memory.title: My memories
memory.hint: In conversations with memory on, the assistant takes the entries most relevant to your question into account; temporary conversations neither read nor write them. Passwords, keys and the like are masked before saving.
memory.forgetPrompt: Enter your current password to delete all your memories. This cannot be undone.
